The volatility-gated momentum test demonstrates that applying a predeclared past-only volatility gate (vol_threshold=0.15) to lookback-5 momentum eliminates the REGIME_STABLE edge observed in the baseline momentum test. While the baseline momentum test showed 7 REGIME_STABLE assets (mostly positive edge), the volatility-gated version shows all 10 assets as CONSISTENT_WITH_NOISE. This suggests that the momentum edge is regime-dependent and vanishes under low-volatility conditions, providing evidence that volatility regime-conditioning may help the momentum mechanism where MA regime filters failed.
